answer: This program's improvement is harness-level (plugin/skill/hook/MCP actually load; fail-closed confirmation; FAIL_TO_PASS test runner), not a weight-level IQ bump. Applicable detectors: agentbench, gaia, swe-bench, tau-bench. Popular inapplicable control: humaneval (static pass@k). OSWorld and WebArena are popular agent benches that still do not measure this harness. Public SWE-bench Verified is inapplicable as a clean improvement meter (OpenAI 2026 audit). E3 headline swev-verbatim-gold cannot promote a mechanism. SUCCESS:RES-0093
